_README: These gates physically block features that are illegal to operate until the listed legal step is complete. Do NOT default any gate to true except cpn_and_rented_tradelines_blocked. Each gate is checked by requireGate() in gate.ts/gate.py. Flip a gate to true ONLY after the human confirms the legal step is done. See root CLAUDE.md section 3.
_launch_scope: VIRGINIA ONLY at launch. multistate_matrix_cleared must be true before any non-VA operator can transact credit/funding services.

croa_contracts_attorney_approved.clears_when: Licensed VA attorney approves CROA-compliant service agreement, separate written disclosure statement, and 3-day Notice of Cancellation.
croa_contracts_attorney_approved.legal_basis: Credit Repair Organizations Act, 15 U.S.C. 1679 et seq.
croa_contracts_attorney_approved.owner_action_required: Attorney sign-off on document suite; store signed approval reference here.

blocks: workstream-2-credit-funding/intake (any paid credit-repair enrollment in VA)
vdacs_registered_bonded.clears_when: Credit services business registered with Virginia VDACS and surety bond posted (100x standard fee; min $5,000 / max $50,000).
vdacs_registered_bonded.legal_basis: Virginia Credit Services Businesses Act, Va. Code 59.1-335.1 et seq.
vdacs_registered_bonded.owner_action_required: File VDACS registration; bind surety bond; record policy number out-of-band (never in repo).

blocks: any Stripe charge tied to credit-repair services
no_advance_fee_billing_enforced.clears_when: Billing logic proven to never charge a consumer before credit-repair services are fully performed (monthly-after-service or per-deletion only). Unit tests demonstrate it.
no_advance_fee_billing_enforced.legal_basis: CROA + Telemarketing Sales Rule advance-fee ban.
no_advance_fee_billing_enforced.owner_action_required: Confirm billing model; review test evidence.

sbf_broker_registered.clears_when: Registered as a Virginia sales-based financing broker with the SCC ($1,000 initial, $500 annual) AND the 9-item disclosure-form workflow is implemented.
sbf_broker_registered.owner_action_required: SCC registration. NOTE: funding desk can launch with cards/LOC/SBA/equipment WITHOUT this gate; only MCA/RBF is blocked.

cpn_and_rented_tradelines_blocked.blocks: NOTHING when true. This gate being true MEANS the prohibition is active. Never set to false.
cpn_and_rented_tradelines_blocked.clears_when: ALWAYS TRUE. This is a permanent prohibition, not a feature to unlock.
cpn_and_rented_tradelines_blocked.legal_basis: Federal fraud (false statements on credit applications); FTC actions (TopTradelines, BoostMyScore).
cpn_and_rented_tradelines_blocked.owner_action_required: None. Keep true forever. Intake/dispute engines must detect and reject CPNs and rented tradelines.

blocks: any pooled-capital / community-fund / multi-investor co-investment vehicle
securities_counsel_cleared_fund.clears_when: Securities counsel clears a specific structure (Reg D / Reg CF / other). DEFAULT PLAN IS TO NOT BUILD THIS — deliver community capital via CDFI + Virginia SSBCI partnerships instead.
securities_counsel_cleared_fund.legal_basis: Howey (SEC v. W.J. Howey Co.); Investment Company Act of 1940.
securities_counsel_cleared_fund.owner_action_required: Do not build a pooled fund. If ever pursued, engage securities counsel first.

blocks: credit/funding services for any operator or client outside Virginia
multistate_matrix_cleared.clears_when: State-by-state compliance matrix completed (credit services registration + commercial-financing disclosure laws in CA, CT, FL, GA, KS, MO, NY, TX, UT, VA) for each target state.
multistate_matrix_cleared.legal_basis: State credit services + commercial financing disclosure statutes.
multistate_matrix_cleared.owner_action_required: Per-state legal review before enabling that state.
